row.title: Hosted packs read the protected policy and the organization's fetch (US-21-R28, R29)
row.body: core/org/index.js passes config.packs.policy, else config.policy, and its own fetch to createPacks, so a class B pack it hosts stays at assisted under the shipped policy and its egress fetch is the org fetch limited to declared hosts. Proven by node --test workers/core/org/wiring.test.js.
